boundary_conditions: roof_u_value * dT_dx(1) = (1 - solar_reflectance + aged_reflectance_loss) * solar_irradiance_daily_mean + external_heat_transfer_coefficient * (ambient_temperature - T(1)) - thermal_emittance * net_sky_longwave

parameters.name: indoor_temperature
parameters.justification: Conditioned interior at 25 C (x=0 is the interior side; roof_u_value includes the interior film).

parameters.name: ambient_temperature
parameters.justification: Daily-mean outdoor air temperature on a hot-climate summer day (35 C; max ~44 C).
